stem.en: How much more acidic is a solution of pH 3 than one of pH 6?
stem.et: Kui palju happelisem on pH 3 lahus kui pH 6 lahus?

label.en: 1000 times — each pH unit is a factor of ten in hydrogen-ion concentration
label.et: 1000 korda — iga pH-ühik on vesinikioonide kontsentratsioonis kümnekordne tegur

label.en: Twice as acidic, since 6 is twice 3
label.et: Kaks korda happelisem, sest 6 on kaks korda 3

label.en: Three times, one for each pH unit
label.et: Kolm korda, üks iga pH-ühiku kohta

label.en: It cannot be said without knowing whether the acid is concentrated
label.et: Seda ei saa öelda, teadmata, kas hape on kange
